resources.string: Starring a folder saves its login encrypted on this device, for that exact folder only. Removing the favorite deletes its saved login. Other logins last only for this session. SMB2 is required; SMB1-only servers are not supported.
Folder is favorited, but its login could not be saved securely. Sign in manually next time.
Login failed. The saved login was discarded. Enter your username, password and domain again for this exact folder, or choose guest access.
